title: Border Stabilize
description: Called when a border (optionally only of the specified world(s)) stops moving.

title: Custom Generator
description:
Not an actual event, but rather an event-level scope used to code a custom generator, with the specified ID. Under the main "event" line you can have three different sub-scopes that handle generation:
initiation: This is called once at the beginning of a world's generation. This is specifically intended for optionally setting the world's spawn, but can also be used for other things you need to do at the start of generation.
generation: This is called whenever a chunk is being generated. All custom generators should use this to do their main generation of the world, using the given chunkdata to set the materials of the blocks in the chunk. Note that no block information beyond the material can be set during this stage. Any block state necessary beyond the material should be set during the population stage.
population: This is called after a chunk and all adjacent chunks (not including ones that are diagonal) have been generated, to add certain blocks on top which may require (or be made easier) by being able to put blocks on more than one chunk (ex. adding flowers). This stage should also be used if you need to specify blockdata in addition to the material.

title: Border is Moving
description: Checks whether the border of the specified world is moving or stable (not moving).

title: Is Beyond Border
description: Checks whether a location/entity is beyond or within the border in its world.

title: Chunk is Loaded
description: Checks whether the specified chunk is loaded.

title: Chunk is Slimey
description: Checks whether the specified chunk is slimey.

title: Change Border Diameter
description: Changes the diameter, or size, of the specified world's border over the specified timespan.
syntax_pattern:
set (diameter|side length|size) of %world% to %number% over %timespan%
set %world%'s (diameter|side length|size) to %number% over %timespan%
set (diameter|side length|size) of %world% over %timespan% to %number%
set %world%'s (diameter|side length|size) over %timespan% to %number%
add %number% to (diameter|side length|size) of %world% over %timespan%
add %number% to %world%'s (diameter|side length|size) over %timespan%
(remove|subtract) %number% from (diameter|side length|size) of %world% over %timespan%
(remove|subtract) %number% from %world%'s (diameter|side length|size) over %timespan%

title: Reset World Border
description: Resets the border properties of the specified world to their default values. These values can be found at https://minecraft.gamepedia.com/World_border#Commands

title: Load Chunk
description: Loads or unloads the specified chunk.

title: Fill Region in ChunkData
description: Fills a region in the specified chunkdata with the specified material:1. Fills a region between two coordinates in the specified chunkdata2. Fills the specified layer of the specified chunkdata3. Fills the layers from the first to the second specified layer in the specified chunkdata
syntax_pattern:
fill region from %number%, %number%, %number% to %number%, %number%, %number% in %chunkdata% with %material%
fill layer %number% in %chunkdata% with %material%
fill layers %number% to %number% in %chunkdata% with %material%

title: Create World using Creator
description: Creates a world using the specified creator, optionally specifying the world's name (this is required if the creator doesn't specify a name).Optionally you can specify that the world should be automatically loaded on server start. See the creator expressions for more information on how to specify the world's name and other settings. If a world with the name (specified or from the creator) already exists, this will just load that world instead of creating a new one.

title: Create World
description: Creates a world with the specified name, optionally with a few settings. Optionally you can specify that the world should be automatically loaded on server start. See the environment type and worldtype type for valid environments and worldtypes respectively. Generator settings can either be custom superflat codes or customized world codes (for customized world codes the worldtype needs to be 'customized'). If a world with the specified name already exists, this will just load that world instead of creating a new one.

title: Delete World
description: Deletes the specified world. The specified world must be loaded in order to be deleted. There should also not be any players in the specified world when it is deleted.

title: Duplicate World
description: Creates a copy of the specified world using the specified string as a name. The specified world must be loaded in order for this to work.

title: Load World Automatically
description: Tells Kosmos whether it should load the specified world automatically on server start. This is useful for simple and straightforward world management without the need for a world management plugin. Don't run this effect with the main world, as Bukkit will already load that world automatically, and this effect can't be used to enable/disable that behavior.

title: Unload World
description: Unloads the specified world. You can specify whether or not to save before unloading (this defaults to true). There should not be any players in the specified world when it is unloaded.

title: Center of Border
description: The center of the specified world's border. This isn't necessarily the same as the spawn.

title: Moving Border Diameter
description: An expression for a certain property of the moving border of the specified world:original diameter: The diameter of the border when it was last stablefinal diameter: The diameter that the border will be when it stabilizesremaining distance: The distance the border still has to go before it stabilizes
syntax_pattern:
(original (diameter|side length|size)|(eventual|final) (diameter|side length|size)|remaining distance until [the] border stabilize[s]) of %world%
%world%'s (original (diameter|side length|size)|(eventual|final) (diameter|side length|size)|remaining distance until [the] border stabilize[s])

title: Property of Border
description:
An expression for a certain property of the specified world's border:
diameter: The diameter/size/side length (Note: you should use 'diameter' instead of 'size' to refer to this property, as 'size' conflicts with Skript's size expression)
damage amount: The amount of damage a player will take per second if they are outside both the border and the damage buffer
damage buffer: The distance (in blocks) outside of the border a player can be before taking damage
warning distance: The distance a player has to be within the border to see the red warning effect
warning time: The amount of time the border should be within of reaching a player to show that player the red warning effect.
syntax_pattern:
((diameter|side length|size)|damage amount|damage buffer|warning distance|warning time) of %world%
%world%'s ((diameter|side length|size)|damage amount|damage buffer|warning distance|warning time)

title: Time Remaining Until Border Stabilize
description: An expression for the timespan remaining until the border of the specified world stops moving.
syntax_pattern:
(time remaining|remaining time) until [the] border stabilize[s] (of|in) %world%
%world%'s (time remaining|remaining time) until [the] border stabilize[s]

title: Block in Chunk
description: The first is the block at the specified coordinates within the specified chunk The second is a center or corner block of a layer, one of the three defaults or a specified number, of the specified chunk.

title: Blocks in Chunk
description:
The first is all of the blocks in the specified chunk.
The second is the blocks between two coordinates of the specified chunk.
The third is a layer, one of the three defaults or a specified number, of the specified chunk.
The fourth is the layers between two specified numbers of the specified chunk.
syntax_pattern:
[all] blocks (of|in) %chunk%
blocks [from] %number%, %number%, %number% to %number%, %number%, %number% (of|in) %chunk%
(layer %-number%|top|bottom|sea level) (of|in) %chunk%
[[blocks] from] (layer %-number%|top|bottom|sea level) to (layer %-number%|top|bottom|sea level) (of|in) %chunk%
layers [from] %number% to %number% (of|in) %chunk%

title: Chunk at Coordinates
description:
The first is the chunk at the specified coordinates.
The second is the chunks between the specified coordinates.
The third is the chunk that contains the specified location.
The fourth is the chunks between the specified locations.
syntax_pattern:
chunk %number%, %number% [in %world%]
chunks [from] %number%, %number% to %number%, %number% [in %world%]
chunk at %location%
chunks from %location% to %location%

title: Coordinate of Chunk
description: The x or z-coordinate of the specified chunk

title: World of Chunk
description: The world in which the specified chunk is located

title: Biome in Biome Grid
description: An expression for the biome at the specified x and z coordinates the specified biomegrid.

title: Current Chunk Coordinates
description: An expression, used in the 'generation' section of a custom generator, for a coordinate of the chunk currently being generated

title: Material in Chunk Data
description: An expression for the material at the specified coordinates in the specified chunkdata.

title: Difficulty of World
description: An expression for the difficulty of the specified world. See the Difficulty type for values.

title: Gamerule
description: The value (or default value) of the specified gamerule in the specified world. Gamerules whose syntaxes contain the word 'rule' are booleans, while all others are integers (as of Minecraft 1.13.2).
syntax_pattern:
do tile drops rule [(default)] [in %world%]
do fire tick rule [(default)] [in %world%]
[(default)] max command chain length [in %world%]
reduced debug info rule [(default)] [in %world%]
natural regeneration rule [(default)] [in %world%]
disable elytra movement check rule [(default)] [in %world%]
do mob loot rule [(default)] [in %world%]
announce advancements rule [(default)] [in %world%]
keep inventory rule [(default)] [in %world%]
do entity drops rule [(default)] [in %world%]
do limited crafting rule [(default)] [in %world%]
mob griefing rule [(default)] [in %world%]
[(default)] random tick speed [in %world%]
command block output rule [(default)] [in %world%]
[(default)] spawn radius [in %world%]
do mob spawning rule [(default)] [in %world%]
[(default)] max entity cramming [in %world%]
log admin commands rule [(default)] [in %world%]
spectators generate chunks rule [(default)] [in %world%]
do weather cycle rule [(default)] [in %world%]
send command feedback rule [(default)] [in %world%]
do daylight cycle rule [(default)] [in %world%]
show death messages rule [(default)] [in %world%]

title: Highest Solid Block
description: An expression for the highest block that isn't air at a specific location. Useful for setting spawns.
syntax_pattern:
highest solid block at %location%
highest non-air block at %location%

title: World from Name
description: An expression for the world with the specified name.

title: Creator of World
description: An expression for a creator with the properties of the specified world.

title: Dimension of Creator
description: An expression for the dimension, or environment, of a creator. This is 'normal' by default.
syntax_pattern:
[the] dim of %creator%
%creator%'[s] dim
[the] dimension of %creator%
%creator%'[s] dimension
[the] env of %creator%
%creator%'[s] env
[the] environment of %creator%
%creator%'[s] environment

title: Generator of Creator
description: An expression for the custom generator of a creator. This will not be set if a creator is not specified to use a custom generator.
syntax_pattern:
[the] gen of %creator%
%creator%'[s] gen
[the] generator of %creator%
%creator%'[s] generator

title: Generator Settings of Creator
description: An expression for the generator settings of a creator. This can be a superflat world code or customized world code (the worldtype must be set as superflat and customized respectively in these cases). In addition, a custom generator might also use generator settings.
syntax_pattern:
[the] gen set of %creator%
%creator%'[s] gen set
[the] generator set of %creator%
%creator%'[s] generator set
[the] gen settings of %creator%
%creator%'[s] gen settings
[the] generator settings of %creator%
%creator%'[s] generator settings

title: New Creator
description: An expression for a creator with the specified name (or no name) and the specified properties. See the WorldCreator type and the Property of WorldCreator expressions for more info.

title: Name of Creator
description: An expression for the worldname of a creator. Not all creators have a set worldname, in which case when creating a world using one you must specify a name.

title: Seed of Creator
description: An expression for the seed of a creator. This can be any string at all instead of having to be a number. This isn't necessarily set, in which case a random seed will be used when creating a world using the creator.

title: Structure Settings of Creator
description: An condition/expression for whether a creator is set to generate structures.
syntax_pattern:
[the] struct of %creator%
%creator%'[s] struct
[the] structures of %creator%
%creator%'[s] structures
[the] structure settings of %creator%
%creator%'[s] structure settings

title: WorldType of Creator
description: An expression for the worldtype of a creator. This is 'default' by default.

title: All Automatic Creators
description: An expression for all of the world creators that Kosmos is currently set to automatically run on server start.

title: All Current Worlds
description: An expression for all worlds that are currently loaded. This differs from Skript's 'all worlds' expression in that it still parses as being a list even if there is only one world at the time of parsing.

title: Automatic Creator
description: An expression for the automatic creator (if there is one) that Kosmos is currently set to run for the world with the specified name.

title: Biome Grid
description: Represents a 2-dimensional grid of biomes. Used in world generators to manipulate the biome(s) in the chunk to be generated.

title: Chunk Data
description: Represents a 3-dimensional grid of itemstacks. Used in world generators to manipulate the blocks in the chunk to be generated.

title: Difficulty
description: The difficulty of a world.

title: Dimension
description: A Minecraft world's dimension, also known as an environment.

title: World Creator
description: A creator is a way to store data about the various properties of a world for creating it, and can be used in the Create World effect and in Automatic Creator syntax elements to load worlds automatically. See the Property of Creator expressions for more information.

title: WorldType
description: A Minecraft world's world type.
type_usage: version 1.1 large biomes superflat buffet customized amplified large_biomes version_1_1 flat normal
